Byte-Latent Inspector Reference

This page is the compact lookup guide for the Byte-Latent JBang inspector family.

Use it when you already know the workflow and just need the right selector, bundle mode, or follow-up command shape.

If you need terminology help first, start with Byte-Latent Glossary.

See also:

  • Byte-Latent Docs
  • Byte-Latent Workflow
  • Byte-Latent Artifact Examples

Quick Cheat Sheet

jbang trainer/trainer_byte_latent_history_inspector.java \
  trainer_checkpoints/byte_latent_demo \
  status

jbang trainer/trainer_byte_latent_history_inspector.java \
  trainer_checkpoints/byte_latent_demo \
  history:sort=-trainLoss:top=3 json

jbang trainer/trainer_byte_latent_workflow_inspector.java \
  trainer_checkpoints/byte_latent_workflow_manifest.json \
  commands:ci

jbang trainer/trainer_byte_latent_train_infer_compare_inspector.java \
  /tmp/byte-latent-a/train-infer-report.json \
  /tmp/byte-latent-b/train-infer-report.json \
  compareSummary

jbang trainer/trainer_byte_latent_train_infer_compare_inspector.java \
  /tmp/byte-latent-a/train-infer-report.json \
  /tmp/byte-latent-b/train-infer-report.json \
  bundle=standard json /tmp/byte-latent-train-infer-compare-bundle

jbang trainer/trainer_byte_latent_train_infer_compare_inspector.java \
  /tmp/byte-latent-train-infer-compare-bundle \
  bundleHealth:ci

Inspector Families

Inspector Main input Use it for
trainer_byte_latent_history_inspector.java checkpoint dir or report path One-run history, summary, status, health, and epoch-level slices
trainer_byte_latent_workflow_inspector.java workflow manifest or workflow bundle dir Fresh/resume/full workflow summaries, run discovery, bundle inspection
trainer_byte_latent_train_infer_inspector.java train-infer-report.json or checkpoint dir Single persisted train+infer artifact inspection
trainer_byte_latent_train_infer_compare_inspector.java two train+infer reports or compare bundle dir Baseline-vs-current compare views, delta selectors, compare bundle export and reopen

History Inspector

Common top-level selectors:

  • overview
  • summary
  • status
  • health
  • ci

History selectors:

  • history:summary
  • history:lastLoss
  • history:epoch=<n>
  • history:sort=-trainLoss:top=3

Use this inspector when you only have one checkpoint run and want the training-side artifact status plus compact epoch rollups.

Workflow Inspector

Common workflow selectors:

  • overview
  • status
  • health
  • commands
  • commands:summary
  • commands:ci
  • commands:ci:mode=fresh
  • inspectfields
  • inspectfields:summary
  • inspectfields:ci
  • runcommands
  • runcommands:all
  • runcommands:summary
  • runcommands:ci
  • runcommands:fresh
  • runfields
  • runfields:summary
  • runfields:ci
  • delta:historyRows

Bundle export:

  • bundle=standard json /tmp/byte-latent-workflow-bundle

Bundle reopen selectors:

  • bundleSummary
  • bundleHealth
  • bundleHealth:ci
  • filesSummary:by=section
  • filesSummary:by=format
  • files:section=runs
  • files:name=overview.json
  • file:overview.json
  • loadfile:section=runs
  • loadfile:section=runs:pick=last
  • loadfile:section=runs:index=0

Use this inspector when you are working at the fresh/resume/full workflow level rather than one checkpoint directory.

Train+Infer Inspector

Common selectors:

  • reportVersion
  • overview
  • overview:ci
  • training
  • inference
  • nextToken
  • nextTokens
  • nextTokensPreview
  • generatedText
  • combinedText
  • commands
  • commands:ci
  • selectors
  • selectors:ci
  • inspectfields
  • inspectfields:ci
  • statusSummary
  • status
  • health
  • ci
  • artifactSummary
  • artifactSummaryLine

Use this inspector when you want the stable persisted train+infer report for one run, without moving into baseline-vs-current comparison yet.

Compare Inspector

Common live compare selectors:

  • overview
  • runs
  • status
  • health
  • ci
  • left
  • right
  • comparison
  • compareSummary
  • compareSummaryLine

Common delta selectors:

  • delta:latestTrainLoss
  • delta:nextToken
  • delta:nextTokens
  • delta:nextTokensPreview
  • delta:nextTokensCount
  • delta:combinedText

Discovery selectors:

  • commands
  • commands:ci
  • selectors
  • selectors:ci
  • inspectfields
  • inspectfields:ci

Use this inspector when you have two train+infer reports and need one direct comparison before exporting anything.

Compare Bundle Grammar

Export:

  • bundle=standard json /tmp/byte-latent-train-infer-compare-bundle

Bundle summary and health:

  • bundleSummary
  • comparisonSummary
  • bundleStatus
  • bundleHealth
  • bundleHealth:ci

Grouped file rollups:

  • filesSummary:by=section
  • filesSummary:by=format
  • filesSummary:by=section:sort=-count:top=3

Filtered file listing:

  • files:section=runs
  • files:name=overview.json
  • files:format=json

File reopen:

  • file:overview.json
  • loadfile:overview
  • loadfile:section=runs
  • loadfile:section=runs:pick=last
  • loadfile:section=runs:index=0

Filtered bundle health:

  • bundleHealth:focus=files:top=5
  • bundleHealth:focus=files:section=runs:sort=status json
  • bundleHealth:focus=files:status=missing:top=3 json
  • bundleHealth:focus=sections:sort=-missingCount json
  • bundleHealth:focus=formats:section=runs json

Reopened compare-result aliases:

  • resultSummary
  • resultSummaryLine
  • resultOverview
  • resultHealth
  • resultStatus
  • resultManifest
  • resultComparison
  • resultPayloads
  • resultSources

Use this path when you want a reusable compare artifact instead of a transient terminal comparison.
